{c_important}Hydra{/c} is now a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill and always Summons a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c}-headed hydra whose attacks explode on impact. 

For each head above {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} that it would have had, the hydra instead grows larger and deals {c:FF44A68E}[Affix_Value_1 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
